representation.canonical: Fixed ordinal records are canonical first-fact cells; pointer/per-file indices remain derived/quarantined. Do not retain a parallel Python dict for every call. Arguments losslessly reconstruct from frozen API constants + descriptor path_id + input_handle_bits + requested; query bytes retained in separate frame slots. Existing public raw facts must map one-to-one; exact enum/bit assignments and independent framing fixtures must freeze before implementing this encoding.
representation.capture: The ORIGINAL captured-input pool alone has S<=33554432 immutable bytes and <=8388608 per original, with one additional original assembly<=8388608. It excludes generated artifacts. Hash-only originals have neither assembly nor blob. Preserve partial original assembly on failed/unknown capture if needed for negative observations; do not assume successful release to claim a lower bound. Generated byte snapshots use their separate store and assembly below.
representation.diagnostics: At most D=2*(N+E+32) fixed1024B immutable diagnostic records: opaque identity, bounded class/phase/message and truncation flags; no recursive formatting. Reserve two error slots before each dispatch that may error (original+formatter). Stop before dispatch if reserve unavailable. Owner primary/secondary original objects stay original; dedup by identity. Messages/args do not grow unbounded, but arbitrary exception objects/compiled code heap still prevents an RSS proof.
representation.endian: little; all raw integer widths exact; no Python bool accepted as numeric
representation.excluded: Python object headers/maps/allocator, compiled module objects, original exception graphs, hashlib internals, ctypes conversion stack, OS/page cache and native model memory are not measured or bounded by these payload sums. 256MiB remains an external resource gate; no RSS/time-fit claim.
representation.fact_flags: Closed bitset preserves scalar/count/error observedness, definedness, invoked, auxiliary acknowledgments, wrapper normal/raised/stopped, ownership transfer, buffer/query definedness and committed fold axes; raw BOOL uses signed32 bits and handle/scalar uses API-typed bits. Zero padding is never defined observed evidence.

Exhaustive offset/enum table must be frozen with format fixtures before serialization source.
representation.freeze_failure: First latch the original exception before diagnostic formatting. A failed allocation/copy/encode/hash/check/freeze produces NO issued snapshot or new byte-evidence capability; release/discard unissued partial snapshot bytes/assembly before any later artifact build when safe. Canonical known raw facts and original ownership rights remain. If release/return is unknown, retain/quarantine that one assembly and do not start another. Known late returned bytes/length are retained as observed but ineligible; no postdeadline positive issuance. Never retry the same artifact attempt to obtain favorable evidence.
representation.freeze_lifetime: Live canonical first-fact tables remain allocated and authoritative in addition to generated snapshots. Build at most ONE generated artifact at a time in an assembly no larger than14800384. Freeze into separate immutable bytes, validate exact length/format/hash under original owner clock, then atomically issue its context reference. Healthy candidate/terminal byte objects are distinct and never alias a mutable canonical table, assembly or each other; closing originals or creating terminal evidence cannot mutate candidate bytes. No iterator-only positive evidence.
representation.generated_bytes: A source-issued GeneratedArtifactContext is a non-owning view of this SAME canonical owner/origin/nonce/registry. It holds actual immutable bytes for each issued kind from the closed store, with source-bound byte length and digest bookkeeping. InputContext.blobs remains only original captured bytes; bulk is absent. New-format checker ports receive the actual generated bytes and must parse/hash/check the complete bytes for the declared artifact. An iterator, section digest, ready marker, reported count or callback ACK is not a substitute for consumed bytes. Existing isolated byte consumers remain unqualified until this real format implementation and source binding exist.
representation.journal_packet_report_lifetime: Journal rows, five compact packets and compact report bytes occupy their reserved slots in GENERATED store while building/issued; do not retain a second joined journal, packet bytes or report bytes outside that store. Registry ACK/attempt/identity references are ordinary live state, not another encoded-byte copy and not a resource/RSS proof. Immutable row bytes are prepared before their own append ACK; journal-close attempt consumes append rights irrespective of ACK, as before.
representation.module_graph: 64B/module +512B name/module +2B per directed edge, <=M*M edges. Closed captured-only import graph; no cached sys.modules fallback.

Final-path evidence lives in its retained complete8202B query frame, with explicit observed/defined flags. Do not retain an additional decoded final-path string or UTF8 pool per file. Decode/validate/compare one path at a time in an independently reserved131072B workspace, then discard that temporary. String/object interpreter overhead remains outside encoded-payload accounting, not silently assumed zero.

transitions.raw_first: Reserve full canonical call slot and close rights under original owner. First raw scalar/count/error assignment precedes fold, cache, hash, copy, allocation, callback or throwable clock. Unobserved is a tagged axis, never numeric0/NULL. Keep observed wrapper return and late known counts/ACKs independent of acceptance.
transitions.stream: One shared buffer. Hash-only ReadFile defined slice -> update hash -> advance generation; captured -> hash then copy into bounded per-file assembly -> advance generation only after both commits. Incremental known/hash/capture axes do not roll back if later work fails. Copy/hash/cache faults stop new work, retain original exception and buffer generation; no failed fold retry.

First undefined count remains unknown, not0. Close once from canonical observed owned handle, even after fold failure; uncertain close never retries.
